analysis_scope: closed E05/E06 public HDF5 scalar observations/actions only; no grasp determination

thresholds.status: posthoc illustrative thresholds; not validated controller parameters

limitations: E06 shares E05 action prefix; not independent repeated trials
Non-gripper motion co-occurs in all three intervals
Fingertip-origin distance is not contact-surface gap
Quiet public state does not establish cloth hold
Model call counts and wall-time savings are not measured
Rows show up to first 50 transitions per interval; summary and source-array hashes cover the full close interval
